∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (F : Module.End ℂ V) (D : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M),
 (∀ m : M, (f m : V) = F (m : V)) →
 (∀ r (m : M), (D r m : V) = divided F r (m : V)) →
 ∀ r, (r.factorial : K) • (D r).baseChange K = (f.baseChange K) ^ r
proof:
intro f F D hf hD r
have hp : ∀ n (m : M), ((f ^ n) m : V) = (F ^ n) (m : V) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro m; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro m
    simpa only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply] using
      (hf ((f ^ n) m)).trans (congrArg F (ih m))
have he : (r.factorial : ℤ) • D r = f ^ r := by
  ext m
  change (r.factorial : ℤ) • (D r m : V) = ((f ^ r) m : V)
  rw [hD, hp]
  simp [divided, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_smul,
    ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℂ, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ,
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero r)]
have hk := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℤ M => f.baseChange K) he
simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_smul, LinearMap.baseChange_pow] at hk
have hk' : (r.factorial : K) • (D r).baseChange K = (f.baseChange K) ^ r := by
  simpa only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul,
    natCast_zsmul] using hk
exact hk'

@checked : ∀ {V : Type} [instVAdd : AddCommGroup V] [instVMod : _root_.Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type)
  [instK : Field K] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p →
    0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
      Coordinates lam x y h v →
        LocalLattice p lam M x y h ∧ MatrixIdentities p lam M x y v →
          PrincipalLattice p lam M y v →
            ScalarReduction p K M →
              ReducedBasis p lam K M x y h v →
                ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (F : Module.End ℂ V) (D : ℕ → Module.End ℤ ↥M),
                  (∀ (m : ↥M), ↑(f m) = F ↑m) →
                    (∀ (r : ℕ) (m : ↥M), ↑((D r) m) = (divided F r) ↑m) →
                      ∀ (r : ℕ), ↑r.factorial • LinearMap.baseChange K (D r) = LinearMap.baseChange K f ^ r
